benchmark.scope: Cached-feature CPU kernel timing only; raw controls are readout-only, bottlenecks include normalization and compression. Synthetic all-one readout weights. Excludes encoder, layer capture, transfers, I/O and fitting; not end-to-end latency.

scope: Offline correctness prediction on an inspected NuminaMath-1.5 test set; verifiable answers only. Metrics average shared-data seeds, not ensemble predictions.
